newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: U.S. pilot dies on Colombian anti-drug mission.
newsitem.headline: U.S. pilot dies on Colombian anti-drug mission.

text.p: A U.S. pilot flying a anti-drug mission in Colombia died when his plane crashed in a jungle area of southeast Colombia on Tuesday, police said.
The pilot, whose identity was not immediately released, was flying a U.S.-registered Turbo Thrush crop-dusting plane and was fumigating illict plantations of coca leaf, the raw material for cocaine.
The cause of the crash was not immediately known.
He was believed to be the first U.S. pilot to die on such a mission in Colombia.
